## Overview

Read @lamontagne_abatement:2019.
Focus on the main text and figures (skip the Methods section and Supplementary Material unless you're curious).

## Wednesday Discussion: Figure Jigsaw

On Wednesday, each person will lead a **3-minute explanation** of one figure or figure group from the paper.
Sign up for your slot on Monday in class.

| Slot | Figure(s) | Focus |
|:-----|:----------|:------|
| 1 | Fig 1a | How did they sample the policy space? Why exponential growth in abatement? |
| 2 | Fig 1b–d | What do the tradeoff clouds show? How is "tolerable" defined? |
| 3 | Fig 2a | Which factors dominate each metric? What's surprising? |
| 4 | Fig 2b–d | How do factor sensitivities shift over time? What's the policy implication? |
| 5 | Fig 3a–b | How do robust abatement pathways narrow as climate sensitivity rises? |
| 6 | Fig 3c + conclusion | What happens at median climate sensitivity? What's the headline message? |

For your presentation, address:

1. **What** the figure shows (axes, colors, key features)
2. **So what** — the main takeaway
3. **What assumption or choice** would change the result

## Prep Question

Each person should also prepare **one discussion question** about the paper (not necessarily about your figure).
Good questions connect the paper's methods or findings to concepts from earlier in the course or to your final project context.
